_doc: Chinese -> English id map used by tools/migrate_ids.py (step 9c-1). Sections: field = dict keys; top = per-file top-level keys; ids = identifiers by category; prefix = name prefixes in effects/conditions; counter = second segment of count.*; class_value = values of the class/slot fields; exact = whole-string replacements; notes = developer-note translations.

notes.12 月 31 日，不占日程。四个场合选一个参加，或休息（疲劳清零）。玩法目前只: Dec 31, takes no schedule slot. Pick one of four occasions to attend, or rest (fatigue reset). The only play mode for now is "ranking"
notes.当年在场的有名对手里取该路等级最高的 5 人: the 5 named rivals present that year with the highest level on the road
notes.成功日技能训练值+收益并扣书的点数；不扣学费，疲劳每天+1，周日不读: On a successful day: skill training value += gain and the book's points are used up; no tuition, fatigue +1 per day, no reading on Sundays
notes.真实日历（含 1928 闰年）；周日不上课、不打工、不拍摄、不看书: Real calendar (including leap year 1928); no classes, jobs, shooting or reading on Sundays
notes.某门课上过的旬数 <=3 为 1 级，<=6 为 2 级，<=9 为 3 级，之: Periods already spent in a class: <=3 is level 1, <=6 level 2, <=9 level 3, after that level 4
notes.判定顺序：强制 → 特殊 → 大类 → 档次 → 品性 → 归宿 → 评语和总分: Resolution order: forced -> special -> category -> grade -> character tier -> destiny -> comment and total score. Within a category the ending list takes the first whose cond holds, by `order`; an empty cond is the fallback
notes.生病指数 100 连续 2 个月（游戏中途触发）。他没能撑过去，认真写: sick_index stays 100 for 2 months in a row (can trigger mid-game). He did not survive; write it seriously
notes.坏但强：城里的私酒都过他的手 [原 魔王]: Bad but strong: all the bootleg liquor in town passes through his hands [orig Demon King]
notes.去了德国，成了那边的偶像；Sil 线在此断掉 [用素材]: Went to Germany and became an idol there; the Sil line breaks here [user material]
notes.取第一个满足的；最高声望所在路相同按 硬汉、情人、文化、手腕: Take the first that matches; ties on top_road go by tough, lover, culture, savvy
notes.最大标签族 = 计数之和最大的族；并列按此表顺序: Top tag family = the family with the largest sum of tag counts; ties follow the order of this table
notes.补漏，GDD 没写: Gap filler, not in the GDD
notes.GDD 的 B 行；A 且相貌 <500 也落在这里（补漏）: GDD's B row; A with looks <500 also lands here (gap filler)
notes.GDD 写“C/D 且没有满 5 期的工”；兜底，其余落到这里的局也归它（补漏）: GDD says "C/D with no job reaching 5 periods"; fallback, any other run that falls through is also filed here (gap filler)
notes.13 节四条线的归宿条件（romance.json），优先: Section 13: the four lines' destiny conditions (romance.json) take priority
notes.归宿叠加在事业结局之后演出: The destiny is played after the career ending
notes.按最常上的课（看书算一门）、最常打的工各给一句: One line each for the class attended most often (reading counts as one class) and the job done most often
notes.原版 TENMATSU_HYOKA：松 300、竹 100、梅 -10；原版 7: Original TENMATSU_HYOKA: pine 300, bamboo 100, plum -10. Of the original's 74 endings only 4 are graded by attributes, the rest are all plum. Which new endings get a tier is undecided, so all use default_tier for now (an ending may add character: [{cond, tier}] to override); user to decide
notes.null=必然；[分子,分母]；分档列表[{条件,值}]取第一个满足的；{分子:: null = always; [numerator, denominator]; tiered list [{cond, value}] takes the first that holds; {numerator: variable, denominator: n, cap: [p, q]}
notes.true 表示逻辑复杂，效果由代码按“说明”实现，数据只给条件、概率和简单效果: true means complex logic: the effect is implemented in code following `note`; the data only gives cond, prob and simple effects
notes.按“顺序”字段，每月最多触发 2 个，其余顺延: By the `order` field; at most 2 fire per month, the rest wait
notes.某部片的演员出事，导演找人顶替。立刻打一场中片试镜，赢了占下一旬拍摄: An actor in some film is in trouble and the director needs a stand-in. Play a medium audition at once; a win takes the next period for shooting
notes.一个无名对手找上门抢这个角色。打一场试镜，输了角色归他: An unnamed rival turns up to take this role. Play an audition; on a loss the role goes to him
notes.他不见了一个月。下月日程作废，四项声望修正各减去当前声望的 10%: He disappears for a month. Next month's schedule is void; the four rep_bonus values each lose 10% of the current reputation
notes.拘留，罚款 min(金钱, 500)，犯罪 +20，曝光。义气 ≥150 时有人: Detained, fine min(money, 500), crime +20, exposure. With loyalty >=150 someone bails him out: fine halved, no exposure, loyalty -30. Also triggered by failing the check in bar bouncer / bootlegging jobs
notes.报纸登出一件事。反派＋犯罪标签计数 ≥3：名气 +10%；否则名气 -15%。算: The paper prints a story. villain + crime tag counts >=3: fame +10%; otherwise fame -15%. Counts as exposure. The newspaper line can suppress it; loyalty >=200 halves the penalty
notes.推销员上门卖特殊货: A salesman comes to the door selling special goods
notes.一句指点：该路一项技能 +5: A word of advice: +5 to one skill of the road
notes.给一次机遇（opportunities.json 的“前辈的机遇”读这个旗标）: Gives one opportunity (the "senior's opportunity" in opportunities.json reads this flag)
notes.给一件最好的装备：GDD 14.2 只列了 4 件前辈的装备，这一档的装备没定义: Gives the best gear: GDD 14.2 lists only 4 senior gear items and this tier's gear is undefined; user to decide
notes.大厂提出长约。签：每月薪水 150，片酬照发；只能报名本厂角色（每板随机 3 个: A big studio offers a long contract. If signed: monthly pay 150, fees still paid; may only sign house roles (3 random roles per board are marked house), house roles give the player's main color +10 style points, and the morals clause applies. May be refused; they come back after a quarter
notes.片厂援引道德条款: The studio invokes the morals clause
notes.先看有没有人帮（义气 ≥150 朋友垫上，金钱补到 0，负债清零，义气 -30；: First check for help (loyalty >=150: a friend covers it, money is topped up to 0, debt cleared, loyalty -30; or the dock countryman); otherwise fight >=50 drives him off (crime +10); otherwise the most expensive item is taken as payment, and with no items fame -10% and exposure
notes.影评笑他的口音。之后 4 个月内，上表演课、礼仪课和读谈吐类的书时，谈吐每个成功: A critic mocks his accent. For the next 4 months speech gets an extra +1 on every successful day in acting class, etiquette class and speech books
notes.片场有人递来一种“提神的东西”: Someone on the set hands over a "pick-me-up"
notes.他自己去找了。阶段到 3 时体力 -30、犯罪 +20: He goes looking for it himself. At stage 3: stamina -30, crime +20
notes.一段剧情，占掉整个下月。认真写，不当玩笑。Sil 在场时 Sil 好感 +10: A story that takes the whole next month. Write it seriously, not as a joke. With Sil present, Sil favor +10
notes.行业自律机构的人来谈话。自律 ≥100 或神父作保：无事；否则警告，下次曝光名气: A man from the industry's self-regulation body comes to talk. discipline >=100 or priest_vouch: nothing happens; otherwise a warning, and the next exposure's fame penalty is doubled
notes.Sil 递来一年的来信统计和杂志对他的一句评价（由标签计数生成）: Sil hands over the year's fan-mail statistics and a magazine's remark about him (generated from tag counts)
notes.日期占位（待用户定，格式 \"MM-DD\"；null 时不触发）。收到来信和礼: Date is a placeholder (user to decide, format "MM-DD"; null = never fires). Letters and gifts arrive; each romance line with favor >=60 gets a small scene; actress favor +3
notes.接受了才能走“帝国银幕偶像”结局: Only after accepting can the "Imperial screen idol" ending be reached
notes.一场带同步配乐和几段说话短片的首映。没有数值效果；Duv 或 Sil 提一句“以: A premiere with synchronized score and a few spoken shorts. No numeric effect; Duv or Sil says "maybe we'll all have to talk someday", and the bookstore stocks the advanced speech books (books.json already handles it by date)
notes.名气 ≥150 受邀入会，记旗标“会员”: fame >=150: invited to join, sets flag member
notes.葬礼剧情。瓦伦从对手表移除；此后板上“异国情人”“浪漫”标签的角色数量 +1（至: Funeral scene. Valen is removed from the rival table; from then on boards get +1 role with the "exotic_lover" or "romance" tag (until the end of 1928)
notes.一部会说话的电影上映。开始出现有声角色（6.4）；乔森加入对手表；电台播音开放（: A talking picture is released. Talkie roles start to appear (6.4); Jolson joins the rival table; radio announcing opens (jobs.json and rivals.json already handle it by date)
notes.谈吐 ≥50 通过；否则进入口音事件的加成期。每局一次: speech >=50 passes; otherwise enters the bonus period of the accent event. Once per game
notes.占位，可并入机遇: Placeholder, may be merged into an opportunity
notes.剧情：股市崩盘。时代背景，没有数值效果: Story: the stock market crash. Period backdrop, no numeric effect
notes.可转女明星保镖: May lead to the actress bodyguard job
notes.客人是圈内人，人脉 +2: The customer is in the business, connections +2
notes.每块板随机一个角色直接显示对手的出牌习惯: Each board shows the rival's play habit for one random role
notes.债主事件时同乡出面挡一次，不消耗义气；码头的随机表加入走私类事件: On the creditor event the countryman steps in once, costing no loyalty; smuggling events are added to the dock random table
notes.“官方来访”时神父作保，视同自律达标；宗教标签的角色上板权重 +1: On the "official visit" the priest vouches, counting as discipline met; roles with the religious tag get +1 board weight
notes.文艺、地下片标签的角色上板权重 +1: Roles with the arthouse and underground tags get +1 board weight
notes.遇上搜查，胆识判定线 40，不过则被捕: A police search: nerve check line 40, failing means arrest
notes.被捕时罚款减半；犯罪标签的角色上板权重 +1: Halves the fine when arrested; roles with the crime tag get +1 board weight
notes.“支持转型”，之后 3 块板各多一个玩家指定戏路族的中片角色: "Backs transition": the next 3 boards each get an extra medium role of the tag family the player picks
notes.丑闻提前一个月知道，可花 200 压下: Learns of a scandal a month early and may pay 200 to suppress it
notes.每年可放一条消息，名气 +10%: May leak one piece of news per year, fame +10%
notes.遇到富婆，富婆好感 +5: Meets the rich widow, rich_widow favor +5
notes.解锁私人男伴: Unlocks the private male companion job
notes.出钱投一部片，下一块板多一个中片角色: Invests in a film: the next board gets an extra medium role
notes.“亲自上”的胆识线从 60 降到 50；西部、动作冒险标签的角色上板权重 +1: The "stunt_self" nerve line drops from 60 to 50; roles with the western and action_adventure tags get +1 board weight
notes.查车，胆识判定线 60，不过则被捕: Car inspection, nerve check line 60, failing means arrest
notes.“入伙”邀请，记旗标（地下皇帝线）: "Join the crew" invitation, sets a flag (underworld emperor line)
notes.封面事件（名气 +15）；浪漫、异国情人标签的角色上板权重 +1: Cover story (fame +15); roles with the romance and exotic_lover tags get +1 board weight
notes.“挡了一下”（体力 -20、女明星好感 +10、义气 +10、名气 +10）: "Took the hit" (stamina -20, actress favor +10, loyalty +10, fame +10)
notes.此后有声角色的谈吐线 -10: From then on talkie roles' speech line -10
notes.被小报拍到，按丑闻曝光结算: Caught by the tabloids, settled as scandal exposure
notes.前辈认可 300 档后必然触发: Always fires after the senior-approval 300 tier
notes.每轮 遵循概率% 按习惯出，其余在剩余牌里均匀随机；“大小”按对当前场风的有效点: Each round follows the habit with probability follow_prob%, otherwise a uniformly random card from those left; "big/small" is ranked by effective points against the current style (counters not counted)
notes.第一轮出最大，之后从小到大: largest in round 1, then smallest to largest
notes.第一轮出中间那张；之后出能赢过玩家上一轮那张牌的最小牌，没有就出最小: middle card in round 1; afterwards the smallest card that beats the player's previous card, or the smallest if none does
notes.落后或平手时出最大，领先时出最小: largest when behind or tied, smallest when ahead
notes.对手的习惯和主色张数 k: the rival's habit and main-color card count k
notes.组牌前排除场风概率最低的一色: exclude the lowest-style-probability color before building the deck
notes.某个角色完整的场风概率和标签: the full style probabilities and tags of one role
notes.每块板一个角色直接显示对手习惯: each board shows the rival's habit for one role
notes.GDD 7.1–7.5 的数字。有效点数按 ×100 的整数算，倍率是百分比整数: The numbers of GDD 7.1-7.5. Effective points are integers scaled by x100; multipliers are integer percentages
notes.主色 = 等级 × (100 + 系数 × 场风概率%/100) 最大的颜色；其: main color = the color with the largest level x (100 + coef x style probability%/100); the other 5-k cards take the "counter of counter" (whoever counters the color that counters the main color), to avoid being countered
notes.显示值 = 基础值 + 服装值 × (0.5 + 打扮显示值/100)，向下取整: displayed value = base + outfit value x (0.5 + grooming displayed value/100), rounded down
notes.同一互斥组只有价格最高的一件生效: Within one exclusive group only the highest-priced item takes effect
notes.书的数据在 books.json，这里只放书店之外来的特殊书: Book data lives in books.json; only special books that do not come from the bookstore are listed here
notes.开局第三问的物品；教育门槛 300，读完事件留空；技能待用户定，没有放进 boo: Item for the third opening question; education gate 300, finish event left blank; the skill is for the user to decide, so it is not in books.json
notes.前辈认可 200 档给；类别和技能都是占位（GDD 只写“该路一项技能 +10，: Given at senior-approval tier 200; class and skill are placeholders (GDD only says "+10 to one skill of the road, +5 to another")
notes.基数；乘加薪档，向下取整；成功日才有薪水: Base amount; multiplied by the raise tier and rounded down; pay only on successful days
notes.按该工成功过的期数: by the number of periods this job was successful
notes.各项各自 属性 - r0(疲劳) >= 值，技能用显示值: each line: attribute - r0(fatigue) >= value; skills use the displayed value
notes.不论成败都结算；加:[a,b] 即 r(a,b): settled whether or not the day succeeds; add:[a,b] means r(a,b)
notes.成功的期结算一次: settled once for each successful period
notes.条件满足时该项成功线加上 值（负数为降低）: when the cond holds, add value to that stat's success line (a negative value lowers it)
notes.月初按名气档扣，可负债；月结效果在月结时生效: Charged at the start of the month by fame tier, may go into debt; month_end_effect applies at month end
notes.体力 <15 且不是“讲究”时强制改回“讲究”: When stamina <15 and the lifestyle is not "fine", it is forced back to "fine"
notes.链事件按顺序、各看一次；链用完或条件不满足时触发常驻事件（可重复）。Duv 的告: Chain events go in order, each seen once; when the chain is used up or its cond fails, resident events fire (repeatable). Duv's tip-off and chat are 1/2 each. Except Duv and the actress the content is blank, user to supply
notes.本旬在该地点、年份和月份命中、条件满足的 NPC 算在场（5.5.2）。玩家在某: An NPC is present this period when place, year and month match and the cond holds (5.5.2). Once the player has met someone at a place, the schedule book records that entry; with connections >= schedule_full_view_line every known NPC is shown
notes.在月末事件里排在“前辈认可”之后判定；每个机遇每局至多一次。效果写在这里（剧情: Judged in the month-end events after "senior approval"; each opportunity at most once per game. The effect is written here (`story` is an event in events.json that holds only the story text)
notes.开局三问，每题选一项；效果语法同物品（14.1）: Three opening questions, pick one option each; effect syntax as for items (14.1)
notes.领事馆找上门的事件；战争片契合加成: An event where the consulate comes looking; war-film fit bonus
notes.运私酒不需要看场子的期数: Periods bootlegging can skip the bar-bouncer requirement
notes.那边的人找上门的事件: An event where people from over there come looking
notes.被认出来的事件；富婆线提前: An event where he is recognized; the rich widow line comes earlier
notes.报馆、片厂办公室的教育线 -20: Education line -20 for the newspaper and studio office jobs
notes.拷贝流出来的丑闻事件: A scandal event from a leaked copy
notes.教育门槛 300，读完事件留空: education gate 300, finish event left blank
notes.外出的随机表事件、NPC 链和常驻事件、家教链事件。选项的判定：null / 门: Random-table events for outings, NPC chain and resident events, tutor-chain events. Option check: null / gate [attr, comparator, value] / {check: skill, line: n} (success if skill displayed value + r0(20) >= line). Content is mostly GDD 11.4 examples; text is for PLAN step 18
notes.遇到一个人，进入恋爱状态；期间日程 20% 失败，四条感情线好感每月 -2 [原: Meets someone and enters the in_love state; schedule days fail 20% of the time, and the four romance lines lose 2 favor per month [orig]
notes.女明星在场时（链事件）: When the actress is present (chain event)
notes.家教课或市中心遇到他时触发（6.5）: Fires when he is met in tutoring class or downtown (6.5)
notes.当前板或下一块板上随机一个中片/大片角色，显示完整场风概率和标签（6.5）: Picks a random medium/big role on the current or next board and shows its full style probabilities and tags (6.5)
notes.占位：内容待用户给: Placeholder: content for the user to supply
notes.外出的去处。花费是每天的钱（或 花费按名气档：无名到巨星五档）；疲劳每天是每天减: Outing places. cost is money per day (or cost_by_fame_tier: five tiers from unknown to superstar); fatigue_per_day is how much fatigue drops each day. random_table is a list of event ids (outing.json). Add a place by adding a row
notes.休息只有两种（用户定）：在家（Sil 陪着，不花钱）和外出（选一个去处，花钱，遇: Rest has only two kinds (user decision): at home (Sil keeps him company, free) and outing (pick a place, spend money, meet people and things). The sanatorium is forced only when very sick and the player cannot pick it. Each takes one period, settled day by day. Resting on a Sunday counts as ordinary rest
notes.当天按在家休息算: counts as resting at home for that day
notes.该旬在该去处触发恰好一个事件: exactly one event fires at the chosen place during the period
notes.等级顺序：硬汉/情人/文化/手腕；阶段从“自”月起生效，名气不写则沿用上一阶段: Level order: tough/lover/culture/savvy; a stage takes effect from its `from` month, and if fame is omitted the previous stage's is kept
notes.彩蛋：只在一个角色里出现，不进年度大事排名和无名对手替换: Easter egg: appears in a single role only; takes no part in the annual ranking or unnamed-rival replacement
notes.主色等级 = 基 + 已过的涨级月个数 + r(随机)；名气里的 h = 从 1: main_level = base + number of level_up_months passed + r(random); h in fame = number of half-years since 1926-01 (first half of 1926 is 0); main color = the color with the highest style probability, second color = counter of counter (level main - second_gap), the other two colors level 1
notes.1926-01 第一块板的教学角色对手: Rival for the tutorial role on the first board of 1926-01
notes.GDD 6.3 的 8 个示例加 1 个教学角色；大片 20 个、中小片 40: GDD 6.3's 8 examples plus 1 tutorial role; 20 big and 40 medium/small roles are added in PLAN steps 16-17. Style order tough/lover/culture/savvy, sums to 100, a single color at most 60 and at least 5. All film titles are placeholders. talkie: true always has it, false never, null is decided by the defaults.talkie ratio when the board is built (GDD 6.4)
notes.玩家当前最高声望的路 60%，其余三色平分；对手为 2 级无名演员: 60% on the player's current highest-reputation road, the other three colors share the rest; the rival is a level-2 unnamed actor
notes.第一块板固定的教学角色（GDD 3.3）；名字、看重、标签都是占位: The fixed tutorial role of the first board (GDD 3.3); name, wants and tags are placeholders
notes.GDD 6.4：1927-10 的板 1 个；1928 年每个角色 30%；19: GDD 6.4: 1 role on the 1927-10 board; 30% of roles in 1928; 80% in 1929
notes.GDD 5.6。表现 P 按 ×1000 的整数：500 + 成功日×500/拍: GDD 5.6. Performance P is an integer scaled x1000: 500 + successful days x 500 / shooting days + bonus skill x 2 (+ stunt_self), clamped to 500-1200
notes.GDD 8。S 按 ×1000 的整数算：B × P × F × T / 10^: GDD 8. S is an integer scaled x1000: B x P x F x T / 10^6
notes.角色池不够时临时生成的占位角色（第 16、17 步补齐角色池后基本用不到）。场风: Placeholder roles generated when the role pool runs out (rarely needed once PLAN steps 16-17 fill the pool). Style: main color 55, others 15; wants = one random skill of the main color's road; tag = a random tag of the main color's set; the big film's second-round named rival is drawn by weight from the 3 highest-level present rivals of the main color
notes.好感 0-100；感情线四条，功能 NPC 挂在打工接口上（5.4）: favor 0-100; four romance lines; function NPCs hang off the job hooks (5.4)
notes.在家休息每旬 +2；让他劝 +2；新年、生日 +3；试镜演砸后 +2；戒断剧情: +2 per period resting at home; +2 when he persuades; +3 on New Year and birthday; +2 after a botched audition; +10 for the withdrawal story
notes.管家（感受条件换成自律）[推N42]: Butler (the feeling condition replaced by discipline) [inferred N42]
